The 30 September digest says Mateo Quiroga submitted ticket #8841 for Door 14 at Newark. The ticket is about drivers at the Newark second shift being unable to select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. It says you escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

Check the number before you send it to engineering. On 1 July in #strategic-pod you wrote that you had closed ticket #8841 with support. That one was about the Detention Summary CSV export and a kiosk browser-cache problem, so it looks like a different issue. The digest may have the wrong number, or the number may have been reused. I couldn't find the ticket itself, so I can't tell which. Mateo's original submission or the support queue should settle it.

The only other ticket I can see for Mateo's accounts is INC-4821, from the 3 August Hartford kiosk outage. It's unrelated to Newark Door 14.
